source_snapshot.criteria: UID is bright blue after on; second line says UID is OFF when turned on, contradicting the explicit off step.

historical_reviews.deepseek: Recognizes hybrid command-plus-visual coverage but does not preserve target identity, exact response semantics, baseline or the contradictory off criterion.
historical_reviews.gpt_v2: Correctly requires owner clarification and makes physical color/state observation independent from command acceptance.
historical_reviews.history: No earlier exact source identity record exists.
historical_reviews.v3_1: An IPMI completion or logical state bit cannot prove physical color, brightness or correct chassis association. The second criterion must also be explicitly corrected or separately interpreted because literal compliance would require the LED to be off after the on command, directly opposing criterion 1.

original_test_intent: Preserve the intended UID on/off transition while recording the Master contradiction: command the target UID on and off, verify logical state where supported and have an operator confirm physical blue/on and off behavior, then restore the original UID state.
original_method: Obtain a ruling that maps each criterion to the on and off steps; verify BMC/chassis and vendor 0x30/0x23 contract; capture baseline logical/physical UID state; issue one approved on transition and collect response/readback plus operator blue/on evidence; issue one approved off transition and collect response/readback plus operator off evidence; restore baseline if different.
manual_activity: The owner resolves the second criterion and approves the command contract; an authorized operator observes the exact physical chassis LED for blue/on and off and confirms baseline restoration.
required_inputs: Vendor on/off command and response schema
Initial logical and physical UID state
Expected blue color/brightness and observation duration
safety_requirements: Never guess OEM raw semantics or readback shape
Change only one verified chassis UID
Resolve the contradictory criterion before execution
Require physical observation for color and off state
Do not treat exit status as physical proof
Stop on target/response/LED mismatch and never auto-retry unknown payloads
agent_execution_scope: Execute one approved on then one approved off transition
Collect complete responses and supported readback
Restore baseline and archive evidence without verdict
engineer_actions: Approve vendor command/readback contract and transport
Observe physical blue/on and off states

command_applicability.original_deepseek_command_fit: The proposed on/off payloads align with Procedure at a high level, but the text repeats off, assumes an undocumented zero-data readback and omits criterion resolution, target proof and baseline restoration.
command_applicability.command_recommendation: After owner/vendor approval, issue one protected documented on payload followed by one off payload, capture complete responses and supported readback, and pair each transition with timestamped physical observation before restoring baseline.
command_applicability.original_parameters_and_time_preserved: The 10/10-minute on-color-off-color sequence is preserved; criterion 2 is gated rather than silently rewritten.

modernized_recommendation.recommended_method: Maintain a state table for baseline, commanded on, commanded off and restored baseline with raw response, logical readback, operator-observed color/brightness/state, target label and timestamp.
modernized_recommendation.difference_from_original_method: Adds explicit criterion disposition, vendor semantics, target correlation and restoration while preserving physical observation.
modernized_recommendation.coverage_difference: Command success cannot demonstrate the correct chassis LED, blue color or off condition, and literal contradictory criteria cannot share one verdict.
modernized_recommendation.risks_limitations: Some platforms offer no UID readback; in that case physical evidence remains authoritative and the lack of readback must be recorded rather than filled by an undocumented raw query.

project_override_considerations: The Project must confirm that criterion 2 means OFF after the off command, or define a separate intended behavior. It must also identify whether the private IB script is authoritative and provide its reviewed revision; no OOB parameter may be guessed.
expected_evidence: Written criterion ruling, approval and exact target identity
Vendor command/response/readback contract and protected transport
Complete on response/readback and timestamped blue/on observation
Complete off response/readback and timestamped off observation
Restored baseline, preserved logs, no-retry audit and engineer verdict

source_conflict_analysis.analysis: Procedure explicitly turns UID on and then off, while Criteria 2 says the UID should be OFF when turned on. Literal criterion 2 contradicts criterion 1 and the off step, so it cannot be silently corrected.

blocked_analysis.analysis: A criterion ruling, vendor command contract and physical observer are obtainable project inputs. Execution becomes BLOCKED if the contradiction remains unresolved or the correct chassis LED cannot be identified and restored.

engineering_decision_request.question: Resolve Functionality row 1673 Criteria 2: confirm whether UID must be OFF after the explicit turn-off command (and treat 'when turned on' as a copied wording defect), or define a different separately accepted behavior; also approve the exact logical readback and physical blue/on-off evidence contract while preserving Master.

review_improvement: Prevents a likely typo from being silently rewritten and prevents successful raw completion from substituting for the contradictory logical assertion and physical LED state.
independent_technical_reasoning: Two independent observables are required: BMC command state and the physical indicator on the identified chassis. Cabling, controller or labeling faults can make one change without the other. Because the source asks blue/on and off, the evidence must correlate each command timestamp to the same LED; a final off-only photo cannot prove the on transition or resolve the contradictory wording.
